about: Polymarket prediction markets: search and list events and markets with live prices, volume, liquidity and end dates; price history, biggest movers, holders, comments, resolution status, and public trader profiles, positions and activity.

commands.summary: Full-text search of prediction events and their markets (current Yes/No prices, volume); sort by volume, liquidity, ending soon or competitive; active or resolved.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order: volume, liquidity, ending_soon (nearest resolution date first), competitive (closest odds)

commands.summary: List events from the public Gamma API by category tag, ordered by volume or another field, with end dates, volume and liquidity; cursor paginated.

params.name: tag_slug
params.description: Category or topic tag slug, e.g. crypto, sports, politics, esports, israel-election (see list-tags)

params.name: closed
params.description: false = open events only, true = closed or resolved events

params.name: order
params.description: Field to order by, e.g. volume, volume24hr, liquidity, endDate, startDate

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Events per page (max 100) (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

params.name: after_cursor
params.description: Cursor from the previous page's next_cursor

commands.summary: Get one event by its slug (from /event/<slug> URLs) with all its markets: outcome prices, token ids, condition ids, volume, liquidity, end date.
Get a single market by its market slug (second path segment of /event/<event>/<market>): outcomes, prices, CLOB token ids, condition id, end date, volume, liquidity.
Fast search returning matching events (with endDate, volume, volume24hr, liquidity and market prices), matching tags and trader profiles (name and proxyWallet address).

params.name: query
params.description: Search text, e.g. bitcoin, or a trader name

commands.summary: Price history (probability 0-1 over time) of one outcome token; token ids come from a market's clobTokenIds.

params.name: token_id
params.description: CLOB outcome token id (long decimal string from clobTokenIds)

params.name: bucket_seconds
params.description: Bucket size in seconds, e.g. 300 for 5-minute points (the UI uses it with interval 1d)

commands.summary: Markets whose price moved the most in the last 24 hours (the Breaking page), optionally limited to one category.
Currently trending topic tags with their slugs and active event counts, for use as tag_slug in list-events.
Top holders of each outcome of a market, by condition id (conditionId from get-market or get-event).

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Holders per outcome (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.summary: On-chain (UMA) resolution status of every market in an event (posed, proposed, disputed, resolved) by numeric event id.

params.name: eventId
params.description: Numeric event id (id from get-event or search-markets)

commands.summary: Events related to a given event slug, with their markets, prices, volume and end dates.
Latest comments on an event or series, newest first.

params.name: parent_entity_id
params.description: Numeric event id (or series id when type is Series)

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Comments per page (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.summary: Public trader profile (name, pseudonym, join date, tier) by proxy wallet address.

params.name: address
params.description: Trader proxy wallet address (0x…), e.g. proxyWallet from quick-search profiles

commands.summary: A trader's all-time stats: trade count, biggest win, profit/loss, volume, profile views.
A trader's open or closed positions with size, average price, current value and PnL.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Sort field (the UI uses CURRENT_VALUE for open, REALIZED_PNL for closed)

params.name: filter_amount
params.description: Hide positions smaller than this many tokens

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Max positions returned (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.summary: A trader's recent on-chain activity (trades, redemptions, rebates), newest first.

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Max items returned (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

params.name: start
params.description: Only activity after this Unix timestamp (seconds)

commands.summary: A trader's profit/loss time series over a window.
